name: pi-elixir
description: BEAM runtime tools for pi — connects to the running Elixir app for live introspection

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:beam
scripts.lint:beam: cd packages/bridge && mix format --check-formatted && mix credo --strict
scripts.fmt: pnpm --dir packages/extension run fmt && cd packages/bridge && mix format
scripts.fmt:check: pnpm --dir packages/extension run fmt:check && cd packages/bridge && mix format --check-formatted
scripts.test: pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:beam
scripts.check: pnpm run check:js && pnpm run check:beam && pnpm run check:integration && pnpm run release:check && pnpm run hex:check && pnpm run pack:check && pnpm run pack:smoke
scripts.hex:check: rm -rf /tmp/pi_bridge_hex_check && cd packages/bridge && mix hex.build --unpack --output /tmp/pi_bridge_hex_check >/dev/null && test -f /tmp/pi_bridge_hex_check/priv/target/bootstrap.exs && test -f /tmp/pi_bridge_hex_check/priv/target/runtime/manifest.ex && test -f /tmp/pi_bridge_hex_check/priv/target/runtime/worker.ex && rm -rf /tmp/pi_bridge_hex_check
scripts.dogfood:smoke: PI_OFFLINE=1 pi --no-extensions --no-context-files --no-session --extension ./packages/extension/src/index.ts --tools elixir_eval --print 'Use elixir_eval with target bridge to return Application.spec(:pi_bridge, :vsn) |> to_string().'
